images.alt:
A full-length fashion portrait shows a young woman walking along a narrow wooden boardwalk beside shimmering water. She wears a loose, natural-colored linen shirt with rolled sleeves and matching wide-legged trousers, both softly wrinkled and translucent where the sunlight passes through the fabric. Her hands rest casually in her pockets as she steps forward in woven sandals. Several delicate necklaces, hoop earrings, and bracelets add small accents to the otherwise understated outfit. Wind tosses her long brown hair wildly around her face and lifts the open tails of her shirt behind her. A small woven bag hangs near her hip. The boardwalk stretches into the softly blurred distance, bordered by dark shoreline rocks on the left and tall reeds on the right. Low, warm sunlight streams from behind her, outlining her hair and clothing while scattering bright points of reflected light across the water. The pale sky and shallow depth of field keep attention on the relaxed figure and the movement of fabric and hair, creating the feeling of an effortless summer afternoon.

Keywords:
summer fashion, linen clothing, boardwalk, waterfront, windblown hair, golden hour, casual style, woven sandals, natural tones, warm sunlight

images.alt:
A fantastical toad-like samurai crouches high in the center of a violent, rain-soaked battlefield. The warrior has a massive, broad amphibian face with rough, mottled gray skin, bulging golden eyes, and a stern expression. Wild white hair streams upward and backward in the wind. A weathered red headpiece bearing a dark spiral symbol rests across his forehead, while torn crimson robes whip around his body. Multiple swords and weapons are strapped across his back and held in his hands. Beneath him lies the enormous body of another amphibian creature, sprawled across jagged black rocks and rushing water. Its battered flesh is streaked with mud and blood, suggesting the aftermath of a brutal fight. Heavy diagonal rain cuts across the entire scene. Towering walls of churning water rise on both sides, debris spins through the air, and a bright fork of lightning tears across the pale gray sky behind the warrior. The composition looks upward toward the crouching samurai, making him appear defiant and imposing against the overwhelming storm.

Keywords:
toad samurai, amphibian warrior, katana, red robes, storm, lightning, rain, fallen creature, raging water, fantasy battle, white hair, dark fantasy

images.alt:
A close, low-angle view looks into the open mouth of a large black plastic garbage bin. At the center sits a pale ceramic urn, upright but slightly tilted, its rounded body and fitted lid smeared with dark dirt and grime. Small flies crawl across the lid and sides, making the otherwise ordinary vessel feel neglected and unsettling. The urn is wedged among shiny black garbage bags, damp cardboard, crumpled paper, decomposing flowers, onion skins, and scattered food waste. Wilted cream-colored blossoms lie across the foreground, their browned petals mixed with refuse. The curved black rim of the bin frames the scene along the top and bottom, enclosing the urn as though it has been deliberately buried within the trash. Shallow depth of field keeps the battered white vessel sharply prominent while the surrounding garbage and background dissolve into soft darkness. Muted browns, dirty whites, and deep blacks give the image a grim, documentary quality.

Keywords:
sealed urn, garbage bin, ceramic vessel, trash bags, decaying flowers, flies, refuse, grime, discarded object, dark still life

Yapay zeka ajanlarının şirket içi üretkenliği bu denli hızlı dönüştürmesi hakkında ne düşünüyorsunuz? Yakında her şirketin kendi "Kai"si olacak mı?

#AIAgents #Stripe #SoftwareEngineering #GenerativeAI (3/3)

Kai'nin başarısının arkasındaki 2 önemli teknik hile:
• 500+ araç arasından modele sadece o an gerekli olanlar yükleniyor (performans koruma).
• Ajan, sandbox dışında konumlanarak kod çalıştırıyor; böylece ürettiği kod ana sisteme asla zarar veremiyor. (2/3)

Stripe, tüm şirketin kullandığı yapay zeka ajanı "Kai"yi nasıl geliştirdiğini açıkladı! Sadece tek bir mühendis tarafından 1 haftada yazılan bu sistem, şu an Stripe ekibinin %83'ü tarafından her hafta aktif kullanılıyor. Peki işin sırrı ne? 👇 (1/3)

external.description:
Stripe just published how their company-wide AI agent works. The bar for building one just dropped to one engineer and one week

It is called Kai. Their own words: a coding agent for non-engineers. You chat, it makes reports, dashboards and documents. One engineer built the first version in a week, and 83% of Stripe now uses it weekly.

The first trick is what gets loaded. They have 500+ internal tools and 1,000+ skills. All of it at once would drown the model, so nothing loads by default. The model picks which skills the request needs, and those skills bring in only their own tools. Two steps instead of one.

The second trick is where code runs. The agent sits outside the sandbox and calls it like any other tool, so code the model wrote can never reach the agent that wrote it.

The ceiling they admit to: past about 150 skills, quality starts dropping. They are still working on that one.
external.title: Yarchi (@undefinedKi)
